title: Wireless Earbuds: Noise-Cancelling, Budget and Workout
metaDescription: Our wireless earbud research: the best earbuds for iPhone, Android, noise cancelling and budgets, plus a buying guide.
lede: The best earbuds for you depend mostly on your phone, how you use them and whether you need noise cancelling.

p: Start with the best wireless earbuds list. If you're unsure which features matter, the buying guide explains noise cancelling, codecs and fit in plain English.
